title: Self-Improving AI Agents Compared: PivoARL vs HASE vs PLACEMEM
angle: Three new frameworks all promise agents that get better on their own, but they bet on different mechanisms — self-feedback, co-evolution, and persistent memory. Here is how they actually differ and which problem each one solves.
rationale: Multiple agent-autonomy papers dropped together; a comparison cuts through the noise for builders choosing an approach.
